data.name: UseHardwareSource
data.value: Use VNA device instead of demo

data.name: PlaybackSourceHint
data.value: Replays the loaded session at its saved frequency range and point count, without interpolation.

data.name: PlaybackOpenSessionHint
data.value: Open a compatible saved session before connecting playback.

data.name: HardwareSourceHint
data.value: Uses the configured serial path and verified profile. Errors keep this source selected; demo data are not substituted.

data.name: DemoSourceHint
data.value: Uses clearly labelled synthetic samples. The serial port is not opened.

data.name: StatusConnectedHardware
data.value: Serial port opened. Start a scan to check the VNA response.

data.name: StatusConnectFailed
data.value: Could not connect to VNA hardware.

data.name: SerialPortHint
data.value: The value is passed unchanged and stored per system. Demo mode does not open the port.

data.name: PortListHint
data.value: The list offers suggestions; a manually entered path is also preserved.

data.name: SingleScanHint
data.value: Press Start for one scan. Clear Hold to start continuous measurements.

data.name: ContinuousScanHint
data.value: Measurements repeat until Hold is checked. The current complete scan is kept; partial scans never replace it.

data.name: HoldAfterSweepHint
data.value: Hold pauses continuous measurements after the current complete scan. Clear Hold to resume.

data.name: MarkerHint
data.value: Left/right click or drag selects M1/M2. Pan: Shift+left-drag or middle-drag.

data.name: ZoomIn
data.value: Zoom in (+): halve the frequency span.

data.name: ZoomOut
data.value: Zoom out (−): double the frequency span, up to the profile range.

data.name: LanguageHint
data.value: The language changes immediately and is saved automatically when the application closes.

data.name: SaveRequiresComplete

data.name: ThemeHint
data.value: Changes apply immediately. The theme is saved automatically when the application closes.

data.name: NightVisionHint
data.value: Red display. Traces use different dash patterns; measurement values are preserved.

data.name: CableLossHint
data.value: Connect the cable to ANT and leave its far end open or shorted. The displayed one-way loss is derived as −Return Loss / 2; connector, mismatch and fixture errors are not removed.

data.name: CableLossFixtureCheck
data.value: Cable is connected to ANT; far end is open or shorted (not terminated in 50 Ω)

data.name: CableLossFixtureRequired
data.value: Confirm the cable fixture above after connecting an open- or short-ended cable to ANT.

data.name: CableLossHardwareDataRequired
data.value: Cable Loss needs a completed hardware scan or a hardware Cable Loss session. Demonstration data is not a cable measurement.

data.name: FilterHint
data.value: Connect ANT to WOB with a through cable for the reference, then replace it with the filter. The plot uses the profile FILTER offset. This legacy scalar response has no verified phase and is not calibrated S21. Hardware Filter scans are disabled until the command is verified for this VNA 1–65 MHz.

data.name: ModeAntennaAvailable
data.value: Antenna reflection view. The current source is demonstration data.

data.name: ModeCableLossUnavailable
data.value: Cable loss needs a verified measurement method and calibrated device data.

data.name: ModeCableLengthUnavailable
data.value: Cable length needs verified resonance data and a confirmed velocity factor.

data.name: CableLengthHint
data.value: Use an open- or short-ended cable and place M1/M2 on adjacent peaks or adjacent dips. The supplied manual warns that measurements below 60 MHz may be poor; determine the cable velocity factor experimentally or from its specification. The manual gives about 0.63 for LAN cable and 0.50 for an outdoor extension as examples.

data.name: CableLengthInvalidVelocityFactor
data.value: Enter a velocity factor greater than 0 and no greater than 1.

data.name: CableLengthMarkerOutsideSweep
data.value: Both markers must match samples in the current measurement.

data.name: CableLengthGapBetweenMarkers
data.value: The sweep has a missing or invalid sample between the markers.

data.name: CableLengthMarkersAtResonances
data.value: Place each marker on an SWR peak or dip.

data.name: CableLengthSeparateResonances
data.value: Place the markers on two different SWR resonances.

data.name: CableLengthSameResonanceType
data.value: Choose two peaks or two dips, not one of each.

data.name: CableLengthAdjacentResonances
data.value: Choose adjacent peaks or adjacent dips; another resonance of the same type lies between these markers.

data.name: CableLengthPickResonanceMarkers
data.value: Set two different resonance markers on the Antenna plot to calculate an estimate.

data.name: ResonanceQHint
data.value: Use a resonance frequency and lower/upper bandwidth edges. For the documented parallel resonance method, set the edge frequencies where phase reaches +45° and −45° around resonance. Q = Fres / (Fh − Fl).

data.name: ResonanceQEnterFrequencies
data.value: Enter resonance and both bandwidth edge frequencies in the profile range.

data.name: GeneratorHint
data.value: The ten frequency memories come from the supplied analyz.ini. Select a memory or enter a frequency within the device profile.

data.name: GeneratorOutputBlocked
data.value: No generator command is sent by VNA Studio. The physical output state is unknown.

data.name: AmateurBandPresetHint
data.value: A preset sets the scan start/stop only; it does not change the device range or authorize transmission.

data.name: BandOutsideProfile
data.value: No VHF amateur band preset fits this profile's {0} MHz maximum.

data.name: ModeXtalUnavailable
data.value: Crystal analysis needs verified filter or reflection measurements.

data.name: ModeFilterUnavailable
data.value: Filter mode needs verified transmission data and its calibration.

data.name: ModeGeneratorUnavailable
data.value: Generator output is disabled until device support is verified.

data.name: ReturnLossOffsetInvalid
data.value: Enter a finite value from −300 to 300 dB.

data.name: AboutProtocolNote
data.value: Device communication is not enabled until the hardware protocol has been verified.

data.name: MarkerQHint
data.value: Rounded midpoint frequency divided by marker bandwidth; this is not calibrated resonance Q.

data.name: SessionAnalysisModeInvalid
data.value: The session analysis mode is not supported.
